proposed_thresholds.interpretation: QA requirements for future implementation; not measured pass results or historic builders tolerances

checks.name: Reproducible baseline
checks.requirement: implementation names its starting commit and working-tree hashes; original source hashes match; all before images remain preserved. Source changes since this snapshot are explicitly described.

checks.name: Independent registration
checks.requirement: the source transform is recorded once per physical view, with at least six held-out S04 landmarks and their residuals. Maximum unexplained physical-view discrepancy is no greater than the provisional 0.20 ft historical envelope. A larger residual fails or remains unresolved until the view/state conflict is resolved; it cannot be fixed by fitting each part independently.

checks.name: Outer outline
checks.requirement: model-projected aft return, body and head are compared to independently traced source boundaries. The aft edge is oblique as selected from the source; the head has its documented contour. For digitization itself, curve-to-reviewed-native-trace deviation must be at most six original pixels outside declared occlusion masks. Report this digital metric separately from AC-02's physical uncertainty.

checks.name: Head anatomy
checks.requirement: eye, brow, hooked beak/mouth region, jaw and feather transition are identifiable in an isolated close-up and represented by named features. Their curves meet the six-pixel trace criterion in the declared S01 mapping. Each interior feature is classified as relief, recess, paint boundary or confirmed through-cut. A polygon with an eye fails.

checks.name: Ornament composition
checks.requirement: aft scroll, name enclosure, forward scroll/vine and neck transition match reviewed trace topology and landmarks. Source branch junctions and intended negative regions survive CAD operations. No sine-wave repetition, arbitrary stock leaves, stipple-as-geometry or invented bridges substitute for source paths. Border and field boundaries come from traces, not just global offsets.

checks.name: Lettering
checks.requirement: seven correctly ordered letters read KATHRYN from each outward face. Individual glyph contour or justified-font residuals, baseline, tilt, bounding boxes, spacing and counters are documented against D3/P1. All glyphs fit within the traced name enclosure without unintended contact with adjacent scrolls. The two sides are shown at matching camera scale. Filled versus outlined treatment is resolved as a representation choice, not inferred solely from line art.

checks.name: Assembly
checks.requirement: every registered part is a valid solid. Boards and intended backing/fixing contacts are within 1 mm at full size; unintended timber-to-timber common volume is below 0.000001 ft3 unless a declared lap/recess is modeled. No unexplained board/spar/rail clash, out-of-wood fixing, disconnected head feature or false contact is accepted. Paint/relief embed is explicitly distinguished from an unintended timber overlap. The repaired spar, post, hull and jib connections retain their regression results.

checks.name: Material and state record
checks.requirement: physical depth, board thickness, backing width, color values and engraving/paint interpretations each carry an evidence class and source or assumption. Existing 0.36 in net relief stand-off, 1.44 in boards, 6.00 in backing and palette remain provisional if not independently resolved. No unsupported historical measurement is labeled verified.

checks.name: Rail relationship
checks.requirement: item-11 rail identity is resolved in profile and plan. Independently traced endpoint stations/heights and their residuals are reported. Any confirmed rail correction is documented separately and preserves its hull connection. A no-collision result alone does not pass this criterion.

checks.name: Final package
checks.requirement: completed SOMA build, actual-export checks, clean committed-tree build, required annotated after views, source/photo comparison, acceptance JSON and refreshed README gallery all identify the same final model. Every TB finding has a disposition. Remaining uncertainty is explicit and cannot be silently counted as a historical-fidelity pass.

completion: All criteria have evidence and dispositions; uncertainty is retained explicitly and never converted into a historical-fidelity pass. Preserve as-found evidence and validate the final committed model.
